name: election-insight-canada
description: A data-driven web application for exploring Canadian federal election results and estimating seat outcomes from polling data.

scripts.frontend:precommit: yarn frontend:lint && yarn frontend:format && yarn frontend:type-check && yarn frontend:test
scripts.backend:start: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.backend:type-check: cd backend && uv run mypy app common loaders scripts
scripts.backend:test: cd backend && uv run coverage run -m pytest -v && uv run coverage report
scripts.setup: yarn install && yarn frontend:install && yarn backend:install
scripts.precommit: yarn frontend:precommit && yarn backend:type-check && yarn backend:test

author: Tom-js-python
